_documentation: Directory Early-Access announcement (scripts/social-post.py --thread). A single Bluesky post: the 'Find your next…' directory poster as the image, with the directory URL in the text (kept as a real https:// link so it becomes a clickable facet). An image embed and a link card are mutually exclusive on Bluesky, and the poster is portrait, so it leads as the image rather than a cropped link-card thumbnail. Dedup key recorded in data/social-posted.json. Compose/verify with --dry-run; publish behind the social environment gate (workflow_dispatch on social-bluesky.yml with thread=directory-early-access).

posts.text:
👥 Find your next co-author, mentor or host.

The NetSec Directory is now in Early Access: an open directory of the European security studies community, filterable by working group, research theme and country.

Working in the field? Add your bio:
https://netsec-cost.eu/people.html
posts.imageAlt: NetSec Directory poster. Heading 'Find your next…' above a dropdown set to co-author, with mentor and host as the other options. Four tiles: filter the directory, mentorship matching, find an STSM host, and a weekly spotlight on early-career researchers. Framed by members' headshots. netsec-cost.eu/people
